answer: Reputation Decay Collateral. Each identity posts collateral that decays with inactivity; the decay curve steepens across an island of low activity, so idle fakes erode to a canyon of near-zero value. Topping up requires escalating payments tied to a zenith threshold, past which identities must re-collateralize at multiples of prior cost. Attacker pays compounding refill fees per identity per cycle to stay credible, making mass sybil maintenance economically unviable.
